claim: A training programme improves test scores more in the trained group than in the untrained group: the mean pre-to-post gain among trained participants is larger than the mean pre-to-post gain among untrained participants, at the two-sided 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: score before the programme, trained group, one value per participant
score after the programme, same trained participants
score before, untrained group, one value per participant
score after, same untrained participants

claim: A drug changes the evoked response more in visual cortex than in auditory cortex: the drug-minus-placebo difference in response amplitude is larger in the visual region than in the auditory region across 16 participants, at the two-sided 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: evoked amplitude in visual region under placebo
evoked amplitude in visual region under drug
evoked amplitude in auditory region under placebo
evoked amplitude in auditory region under drug

sizes: 16 participants, every participant measured in both regions and both conditions.

claim: The relationship between sleep duration and memory score is stronger in older adults than in younger adults: the correlation between hours of sleep and recall score is higher in the older group than in the younger group, at the one-sided 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: average nightly sleep in hours, younger group
recall score, younger group
average nightly sleep in hours, older group
recall score, older group

claim: Adding nutrients to experimental ponds raises algal biomass: mean biomass in the fertilised ponds is higher than in the unfertilised ponds, at the two-sided 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: algal biomass per water sample, fertilised ponds
algal biomass per water sample, unfertilised ponds

sizes: 4 ponds per treatment, 10 water samples per pond (80 values in total).

claim: Mussel growth increases with the amount of food supplement given to a tank: the regression slope of growth on the supplement dose is positive, at the one-sided 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: supplement dose assigned to each tank
shell growth of each measured mussel, in the tank given by the first axis

sizes: 12 tanks, 8 mussels per tank (96 growth values).

claim: Mowing raises plant species richness in grassland: mean species richness in mown plots is higher than in unmown plots, at the two-sided 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: species count in each mown plot at each monthly survey, in time order
species count in each unmown plot at each monthly survey, in time order

sizes: 6 plots per treatment, 12 monthly surveys per plot (144 values in total).

claim: Neurons in knockout mice have larger mean firing rates than neurons in wild-type mice, at the two-sided 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: firing rate of each recorded cell, knockout animals
firing rate of each recorded cell, wild-type animals

sizes: 6 animals per genotype, 20 cells per animal (240 cells in total).

claim: Trial-by-trial neural activity in a frontal region is positively related to reaction time: the correlation between activity and reaction time is greater than zero at the one-sided 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: reaction time on each trial, trials in time order within a participant
frontal activity estimate on the same trial

sizes: 12 participants, 25 trials each (300 trials in total).

claim: Applying the drug to brain slices increases the mean amplitude of synaptic responses relative to vehicle: mean response amplitude is higher with the drug than with vehicle, in slices taken from the same animals, at the two-sided 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: response amplitude of each cell recorded in drug-treated tissue
response amplitude of each cell recorded in vehicle-treated tissue from the same animals

sizes: 8 animals, 25 cells per condition per animal (200 cells per array).

claim: Reaction time depends more strongly on stimulus contrast in the attended condition than in the unattended condition: the regression slope of reaction time on contrast is steeper in the attended condition than in the unattended condition across 30 participants, at the two-sided 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: stimulus contrast level shown to each participant
mean reaction time in the attended condition
mean reaction time in the unattended condition, same participants

sizes: 30 participants, each measured in both conditions.

claim: Across participants, grip strength is positively correlated with cortical thickness in the motor cortex: the correlation between the two measures is greater than zero at the one-sided 0.05 level.

data_keys.shape: (10, 2) axes: (participants, sessions: before and after the intervention)
data_keys.meaning: grip strength at each of the two sessions

data_keys.shape: (10, 2) axes: (participants, sessions: before and after the intervention)
data_keys.meaning: motor cortex thickness measured at the same session

sizes: 10 participants, 2 sessions each (20 measurements in total).

claim: Over three practice sessions the trained group improves faster than the control group: the average per-session change in performance is larger in the trained group than in the control group, at the two-sided 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: performance score of each trained participant at each session
performance score of each control participant at each session

sizes: 14 participants per group, 3 sessions each (84 values in total).
